Update the WAN MTU to 1492 to support PPPoE encapsulation.

Site notes: the firewall is `fw` (ssh fw). Set it with `set-wan '{"interface":"wan","mtu_size":1492}'` (writes /etc/nb/wan.conf; on invalid input it falls back to the defaults in /etc/nb/wan.defaults).
Diagnosis: routine change -- set the WAN MTU for PPPoE.
Plan: set-wan '{"interface":"wan","mtu_size":1492}'
